name: Memory Load.
source:
Man character wakes up with amnesia. Two girls are around him. Gradually pieces of memories start to collect together. And when truth is revealed, there is an important choice to make.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-december-2008-428-fuusa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
男人角色醒来时患有失忆症。他的身边有两个女孩。渐渐地，记忆的碎片开始聚集在一起。当真相被揭露时，就需要做出一个重要的选择。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-december-2008-428-fuusa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
